// Wrong on purpose: close() only marks a ticker closed; every screen ever opened stays referenced.
import type { ModuleContext } from "@get-modular/resources";
import type { QuotesDeps, QuotesProduct, Screen, Ticker } from "./h-requests.types.js";

export async function createQuotesModule(deps: QuotesDeps, { resources }: ModuleContext): Promise<QuotesProduct> {
  const entries: { readonly screen: Screen; open: boolean }[] = [];
  deps.settings.watch(deps.settings.read(["eurUsd"]), {
    resources, name: "quotes/rate",
    onChange: ({ values }) => {
      for (const entry of entries) {
        if (!entry.open) continue;
        try { entry.screen.show(values.eurUsd); } catch (cause) { void cause; }
      }
    },
  });
  const openTicker = (screen: Screen): Ticker => {
    screen.show(deps.settings.read(["eurUsd"]).values.eurUsd);
    const entry = { screen, open: true };
    entries.push(entry);
    return { close: async () => { entry.open = false; } };
  };
  return { instance: undefined, capabilities: { "acme/quotes": { convert: (eur) => eur * deps.settings.read(["eurUsd"]).values.eurUsd, openTicker } } };
}
